summary: EnerSys filed an Item 8.01 8-K announcing the appointment of Navi Grewal as Chief Digital, AI and Information Officer, effective October 16, 2026. Grewal reports to President and CEO Shawn O'Connell and joins the Executive Leadership Team, overseeing global digital, AI, IT, cybersecurity and enterprise data strategy. She most recently served as Global Chief Digital and Technology Officer at MasterBrand Cabinets, with prior roles at DuPont, Church & Dwight, Campbell Soup and Exelon. This is a routine executive appointment, not a forced departure, so no special-situation or deal terms apply.
